pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 1.3.1 WORD CLASS: DEMONSTRATIVE DETERMINERS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Class: Demonstrative Determiners

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Class: Demonstrative Determiners. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do you identify objects that are near or far?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify demonstrative determiners: this, these, that, those, in a variety of texts
2. use demonstrative determiners: this, these, that, those correctly

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify demonstrative determiners: this, these, that, those, in a variety of texts
   In simple words: practise until you can identify demonstrative determiners: this, these, that, those, in a variety of texts. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use demonstrative determiners: this, these, that, those correctly
   In simple words: practise until you can use demonstrative determiners: this, these, that, those correctly. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Class: Demonstrative Determiners using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Class: Demonstrative Determiners in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Class: Demonstrative Determiners to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Class: Demonstrative Determiners.
4. Show that you can: identify demonstrative determiners: this, these, that, those, in a variety of texts

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Class: Demonstrative Determiners using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Class: Demonstrative Determiners important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read sentences containing demonstrative determiners in print or electronic materials,
2. Construct sentences using demonstrative determiners with peers,
3. Self-efficacy is enhanced as the learner uses demonstrative determiners in sentences correctly.
4. Communication and Collaboration is achieved as the learner works with peers in constructing sentences using demonstrative determiners.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you identify objects that are near or far?
2. How do we show that objects being referred to are singular or more?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify demonstrative determiners: this, these, that, those, in a variety of texts
2. use demonstrative determiners: this, these, that, those correctly

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
